source_request: 메트로폴리탄 미술관 소장품 30.75.3의 장식된 뒷면을 박물관에서 전시 촬영한 듯한 사진으로 보여 주세요. 사람 없이 옷을 넓게 펼쳐 받쳐 두고, 카메라는 뒷면을 똑바로 마주 보게 해 주세요. 따뜻한 주황빛 바탕의 위쪽 가운데에는 여러 층의 건물과 부채처럼 퍼지는 색 띠가 들어간 큰 둥근 장식이 있고, 그 위 왼쪽에는 붉은 원, 오른쪽에는 밝은 원이 보이게 해 주세요. 몸판에는 구불구불한 여러 색의 구름과 흰 새들이 퍼져 있고, 양쪽 가장자리는 길고 좁은 장식 띠로 둘러져 있어요. 아래쪽에는 검은 선으로 몸판과 구분된 넓은 가로 띠가 옷 너비를 따라 이어지며, 그 안에 길게 굽이치는 동물들과 물결 같은 무늬가 보이게 해 주세요. 위에서 밑단까지 전체 모양이 잘리지 않도록 담고, 은은한 전시장 조명 아래 천의 결, 자수의 두께와 금빛 실의 반짝임이 실제 사진처럼 드러나게 해 주세요.
interpreted_intent: Preserve the independently observed decorated back of the specified museum object as a full-outline, person-free display photograph. The principal arrangement is the upper central circular ornament and its upper pair of circles, the patterned field, the narrow sides, and the distinct lower decorated strip. A restrained pale surround is an agent choice that lets a viewer study the actual textile surface; this is a static display, with no invented event or wearer.
subject: The Metropolitan Museum of Art's robe, object 30.75.3
event: The garment rests spread wide on a discreet support
visual_priorities: Keep the full decorated back legible as one supported textile.
Read the upper central ornament and the two circles above it in their requested positions.
Preserve the separation between the main cloud-and-bird field, the side strips, and the lower animal-and-wave strip.
Show cloth and embroidery relief through soft gallery light.
baseline_prompt_en: A museum display photograph presents the decorated back of The Metropolitan Museum of Art's robe, object 30.75.3. The garment rests spread wide on a discreet support, in a garment-only display. The capture camera gives a straight-on back view of the robe, with the entire outline visible from the raised top to the bottom hem. On the warm orange ground, a large round ornament near the upper center contains a many-tiered building and colored stripes spreading like a fan. A red circle sits above it to the left and a pale circle above it to the right. Multicolored curling clouds and white birds spread across the main field, while long narrow decorative strips frame both side edges. A broad horizontal strip runs across the lower part of the garment, separated from the main field by a black line; winding animals and wave-like patterns fill that lower strip. Soft gallery light reveals the cloth weave, raised embroidery, and small gleams in the gold-colored threads. A quiet pale wall surrounds the supported textile, leaving enough space around its whole silhouette to make the arrangement and worked surface easy to study.
